name: Haunt's visage wears the Reaper's transmogrified chest (#9260)
contract: Haunt 573425 summons the visage 840000 and the Reaper casts Clone Me 45204 on it, so the client draws the
visage from SMSG_MIRRORIMAGE_DATA (opcode 1026), which the server sends for CMSG_GET_MIRRORIMAGE_DATA (1025).
Its payload is the visage GUID (two words), the creator display, two words of race/gender/class/skin/face/
hair bytes and the guild id, then eleven item display ids in the order head, shoulders, shirt, chest, ...;
the chest display is word 9. The Reaper wears Apprentice's Robe 56; ObjectMgr replaces item_template displays
with Item.dbc, where 56 is display 9651 and Neophyte's Robe 6098 is display 9683.
Appearances.dbc row 6720 is category 4 (chest) with SourceItem 6098;
CoA.UnlockLocalAppearanceCatalog collects it. Applying it changes the Reaper's visible chest to 6098, so
the copy must then report 9683 while the same visage reported 9651 before the transmog.

steps.label: SETUP: the Reaper wears Apprentice's Robe
Haunt is only castable while stealthed
Request the visage's mirror image without a transmog
SETUP: one mirror image answer arrives
CONTROL: without a transmog the copy wears Apprentice's Robe
SETUP: the chest transmog is accepted
SETUP: the Reaper shows Neophyte's Robe
SETUP: the Reaper still wears Apprentice's Robe
Request the same visage's mirror image after the transmog
SETUP: a second mirror image answer arrives
The copy wears the transmogrified Neophyte's Robe
